commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka under Never-Writes-Twice. I hold two Seal-Stones (Blackrose, Gemin). The third lies in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and all three go into the gate at Teku-Sul Spire. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is a rival. 2. Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard of Vorannuhl, then open the bronze vault door. 3. Lift the key from him unseen (pickpocket) or kill him and take it. I favour force. There are also Sarpa raiders and Plague-Dead around. 4. I do not know why the Unbound seal the trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. I could find out by exploring and talking to people.

answer 1. I killed Hesh-Var and have the Bronze Key. Plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls and a wraith lord guards the vault with the third seal-stone. 2. I do not know what the wraith lord is or how strong; I could find out by looking when I get there.
use Door to Vault of the Household
